data.one_liner: High‑level Dart APIs for encryption, decryption, signing and secure random generation.
data.what_it_does: Provides easy‑to‑use wrappers around PointyCastle for symmetric (AES, Salsa20, Fernet) and asymmetric (RSA) cryptography. Includes a CLI tool for generating cryptographically secure random bytes.
use_when: You need to encrypt/decrypt data locally on any platform (mobile, web, desktop).
You require simple RSA signing/verification or Fernet token handling.
You want a quick way to generate secure random keys or IVs via a CLI.
avoid_when: You need password hashing (use the dedicated password package).
You require fine‑grained control over low‑level cryptographic primitives.
strengths: Broad algorithm support (AES modes, RSA, Salsa20, Fernet).
Cross‑platform (Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, Linux).
Simple, declarative API with built‑in secure‑random CLI.
weaknesses: Relies on PointyCastle, adding an extra dependency layer.

alternatives.name: crypto
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides basic hash functions with no encryption API, useful if you only need hashing and want fewer dependencies.
